name: adarsh-mobile-shell
description: Capacitor Android shell that loads the Adarsh mobile PWA.

scripts.sync:android: npm run prepare && npx cap sync android
scripts.copy:android: npm run prepare && npx cap copy android
scripts.open:android: npm run sync:android && npx cap open android
scripts.run:android: npm run sync:android && npx cap run android
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.verify: npm run doctor && npm run sync:android
